title: Written in development and lost in ageing: the grammar of cellular identity
title_zh: 在发育中书写，在老化中丢失：细胞身份的语法
abstract: Ageing has been described through many theoretical frameworks, yet its mechanistic basis remains unresolved. Here we propose that ageing reflects progressive decanalization of mammalian cell identity, driven by erosion of a regulatory grammar written during development. Extending Waddington’s epigenetic landscape, development canalizes cell fates through globally coordinated chromatin programs that establish identity constraints across multiple timescales. Subsequently, these constraints can only be maintained through local mechanisms with limited fidelity. The asymmetry between high-fidelity writing and imperfect maintenance generates predictable drift that accumulates with biological time. Antagonistic chromatin pathways, particularly polycomb repressive complex 2 (PRC2)-mediated repression opposed by H3K4/36 methylation and RNA polymerase II binding, enforce identity boundaries through mutual constraint. With age, this balance erodes. Consistent with this framework, the vast majority of age-associated DNA methylation gain in somatic mitotic tissues occurs at PRC2-bound low-methylated regions, indicating that these domains function as conserved coordinates of slow-layer drift. This model explains cross-tissue ageing signatures, developmental timing-to-lifespan correlations and robustness of pan-mammalian epigenetic ageing clocks. It provides testable predictions for interventions that stabilize architecture to preserve cellular identity and function. Ageing reflects progressive decanalization of mammalian cell identity, driven by erosion of a regulatory grammar written during development.
abstract_zh: 老化已通过许多理论框架描述，但其机制基础仍未解决。此处我们提出，老化反映了哺乳动物细胞身份的渐进解码，由在发育期间书写的调控语法侵蚀驱动。延伸Waddington的表观遗传景观，发育通过全局协调的染色质程序对细胞命运进行解码，在多个时间尺度上建立身份约束。随后，这些约束只能通过具有有限保真度的局部机制维持。高保真写入与不完美维持之间的不对称性产生可预测的漂移，随生物时间累积。拮抗的染色质通路，特别是多聚阻滞复合物2（PRC2）介导的抑制与H3K4/36甲基化和RNA聚合酶II结合相互作用，通过相互制约来执行身份边界。随着年龄增长，这种平衡侵蚀。一致于此框架，大多数与年龄相关的体细胞有丝分裂组织中的DNA甲基化增益发生在PRC2结合的低甲基化区域，表明这些域作为慢层漂移的保守坐标。该模型解释了跨组织老化特征、发育时间到寿命相关性以及泛哺乳动物表观遗传老化钟的鲁棒性。它为旨在稳定架构以保存细胞身份和功能的干预措施提供了可检验的预测。老化反映了哺乳动物细胞身份的渐进解码，由在发育期间书写的调控语法侵蚀驱动。
